registered_before: any P5-N2 simulation is scored or any P5-N2 discharge current / thrust prediction is inspected. Known: the measurement audit (PR #26) and the blind state envelope (chemistry-state quantities only, measured targets removed).
decided_by: project owner (decisions D1-D6, 2026-09-26); operational details O1-O5 proposed by Claude and NOT frozen until the owner confirms them
purpose: no-retuning discrimination of the 9 ScaledGaussianBohm screening candidates on P5-N2 (promotion rule, CLAUDE.md next work 1)
no_retuning: transport parameters, chemistry, numerics (200 cells, dt 5 ns, 2 ms, average 1-2 ms), wall model and B-field hypotheses are fixed for every run; no parameter is adjusted per case, per point or after results are seen

D1_observables.non_gating_diagnostic: E x B species acceleration voltages V_a,N2+ and V_a,N+ at N1-N3: signed residuals and species ordering are recorded; never used to admit or reject (the 1 m far-field observation operator is not modelled)

D2_thrust_N4_N5: not scored; measured values reported as unscored supporting evidence; no divergence factor is invented or extrapolated

D3_tolerances.discharge_current: |I_d,sim - I_d,exp| / I_d,exp <= 0.15 at each point (the P5-Xe blind scale; not tightened)
D3_tolerances.thrust_definition: |T_axial,sim - T_obs| <= tolerance, T_axial,sim = T_1D x f_reading, f from the audit (reading A: sqrt(Psi_b as plotted); reading B: consistent with measured thrust)
D3_tolerances.divergence_readings: a discrete layer-1 nuisance (D5), not added to the tolerance

D4_modes.never_crossed: a facility run is never compared with a vacuum-corrected target or vice versa

D5_layer1.members: 3 registrations (L38-hist, L32-anode, L32-exit) x 2 coil shapes (1.6 kW, 3.0 kW scaled to 130 G; field-shape hypotheses) x 2 divergence readings (A, B) = 12 per mode
D5_layer1.global: a layer-1 member is fixed across the whole N1-N5 series; never chosen point by point
D5_layer1.across_chemistry: the same layer-1 member must support the candidate across all four mandatory chemistry configurations
D5_layer1.vacuum_admission: a candidate is PROMOTABLE iff there exists one layer-1 member such that, for every mandatory chemistry configuration and every point, the vacuum run is PASS on every primary criterion

run_count.mandatory: 9 candidates x 4 chemistry x 30 cases (5 points x 3 registrations x 2 coils) x 2 modes = 2160 runs; readings A/B are post-processing
run_count.staged: 9 x 30 x 2 = 540 runs per sensitivity branch when run

pending_owner_confirmation.O1_extinction: Operational SUSTAINMENT failure: the averaging-window mean I_d is below 10 % of the measured I_d, or the last 10 % of the window has mean I_d below 1 % of the window mean (the discharge has died). A run that stays lit but whose instantaneous minimum dips below 1 % of the mean (the existing bookkeeping flag 'sustained' in hall_map_schema_v1) is NOT a SUSTAINMENT failure; its I_d RMS, peak-to-peak and frequency are reported and it is scored on CURRENT/THRUST. Rationale: the schema defines that flag as bookkeeping, and deep breathing is not extinction.
pending_owner_confirmation.O2_precedence: per run: NUMERICAL_FAILURE, then OUT_OF_DOMAIN, then FAIL_VALIDATION (all failing reasons listed), then PASS. The chemistry-domain test for OUT_OF_DOMAIN is f_out <= 1e-12 for every reaction and no unresolved table, evaluated independently of the sustained flag (the bridge's chemistry_trustworthy also requires sustained, so it cannot be used alone once extinction is a validation outcome).
pending_owner_confirmation.O3_candidate_verdict: per layer-1 member (vacuum, 4 chemistry x 5 points): PASS if every run PASS; FAIL if any run FAIL_VALIDATION; otherwise INCONCLUSIVE (some run OUT_OF_DOMAIN or NUMERICAL_FAILURE, none failing). Candidate: PROMOTABLE if any member PASS; else INCONCLUSIVE / NOT ELIGIBLE if any member INCONCLUSIVE; else FAIL_VALIDATION (falsified under every layer-1 member). Facility verdicts are reported the same way and do not gate.
pending_owner_confirmation.O4_staged_escalation_trigger: A staged sensitivity branch (run for the nominal chemistry only, x 9 candidates, both modes) escalates to the other three mandatory chemistry combinations if, for any candidate and any layer-1 member, it (a) changes any run status or the member or candidate verdict, or (b) shifts a scored observable by at least half its tolerance: |delta I_d| >= 7.5 % of I_d,exp, or |delta T_axial| >= 2.6 mN (1 sigma). Branches: Johnson-low, rotational-off, HMS x0.5, HMS x1.3, molecular N2^2+.
pending_owner_confirmation.O5_ExB_model_observable: V_a,n,model = m_n u_n^2 / (2 Z e) from the ion velocity at the domain outlet, per species; reported against the E x B values as a signed residual and as the ordering V_a(N+) > V_a(N2+).
